title: Most news feeds are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
It is a subtle but important difference. When an algorithm is built solely for engagement, it often prioritizes outrage or sensationalism because those topics trigger immediate reactions. But a recommendation engine can be built differently. It can be built to learn what you actually care about over time.

At Headlinne, we look at personalization as a way to respect your time. Instead of guessing what might make you click based on broad demographics, our system learns from your reading habits. If you skip a story on tech policy but dive deep into renewable energy updates, the engine adjusts. It is not about creating a filter bubble. It is about curation that evolves alongside your interests.

True personalization means you see the stories that matter to you without having to hunt for them. It is the difference between being bombarded with noise and having a digital assistant that knows your priorities.
cta: You can see how we are building a better way to read at HEADLINNE.com.
